The structure of Dy8Mg2 (reduced formula Dy4Mg) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms and 2 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives both Dy and Mg centers a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each: Dy is surrounded by 8 Dy and 4 Mg neighbors, while Mg has 12 Dy neighbors, all at distances of 3.3519–3.5591 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies Dy–Dy 12-vertex polyhedra with corner-, edge-, and face-sharing, and Dy–Mg pairs with edge-sharing.
